notes.title: Update 0.5
notes.content:
[b] Bug fixes: [/ b]
-Names and hud no longer rotate with characters.

[b] Update: [/ b]
-The master will be able to use the pet controls too.
-The inventory is loaded more efficiently.
-Objects are stackable on the floor.

[b] Added content: [/ b]
-A new inventory system has been added. Players will be able to equip items, they will have slots for coins and equippable items.
-Statistics system. The master will be able to level up the players and they can put the stats.
-Equipped objects provide statistics if they have them.
-A system has been added to have consumable items that increase any stat.
-When you put the mouse over the objects, they will show descriptions.
-Each object will have its life bar and mana.
-The players will be able to see the life bars and mana of the enemies if they have more intuition than they level.
-Players can turn lights on and off by clicking them close to them.
-Statistics are calculated according to the "La Historia De" rpg system.
-Each player can modify the texts of the game as they wish and put them in their language.
-Clicking on the life / mana bars you can lose or gain life / mana.
-An indicator has been added that shows the character that is being controlled.

[b] Notes: [/ b]
This is the first major update to the game. The tutorials are out of date and will be updated with videos in the following weeks. There are still examples of everything in the "Tutorial" game. In the game folder "La Historia De"

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.04
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Button added to close the game in the upleft corner. No longer you close accidentally the game pressing "Esc".
[*] Now you can move "Decorations" if you are near them by clicking them.
[*] No longer the light overlap infinitely.
[*] Now lights should be more real. The lights blend with each other.
[/list]
